summary: No public dataset holds animal-level voltage maps or ectopic-eye scoring for ion-channel misexpression in Xenopus; searches of Dryad, Zenodo, GEO, BioStudies and DataCite found only unrelated Xenopus records, and Xenbase is behind a reCAPTCHA. The numbers live in the original papers (e.g. Pai et al. 2012, Development) as figures and text.
next_step: Compile induction counts, sites and sample sizes from Pai et al. 2012 (Development) and the Pax6 ectopic-eye literature into a table, then pre-register a comparison; Xenbase phenotype annotations would need browser access.
obstacles_confirmed: Animal-level voltage and morphology tables are not deposited.
